# Disaster Response Hub — LLM Cost Burn-Down

Monthly LLM cost (AUD) accumulated per scope vs the published budget. Spec-032 T509 (evidence) FR-O04.

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == 'llm.cost.aud_micros'
| extend scope = tostring(Properties.scope)
| summarize cost_aud = sum(Sum) / 1000000.0 by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), scope
| render areachart with (title='LLM cost (AUD) per scope per hour')

AppMetrics
| where Name == 'llm.budget.warning_total'
| extend scope = tostring(Properties.scope)
| summarize warnings = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), scope
| render columnchart with (title='Budget warning events per scope (>=80% burn)')

AppMetrics
| where Name == 'llm.tokens.total'
| extend model = tostring(Properties.model)
| summarize tokens = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), model
| render barchart with (title='LLM tokens consumed per model')
